page_title: UDI 0-3 BOL | Udinese v Bologna 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' 0 - 3 Goal! Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 0:3.
90+3' Bologna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) steps up to send the ball in.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
86' A pass by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
85' Substitution. Santiago Castro walks off the pitch and Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) comes on as a substitute.
84' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Benjamin Dominguez will be replaced by Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
78' Here's the change. Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) leaves the pitch and Giovanni Fabbian comes on as a substitute.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahim Sulemana (Bologna) trots off the pitch and is replaced by Riccardo Orsolini.
71' That's the end of the game for Jurgen Ekkelenkamp, who is replaced by Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese).
71' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Hassane Kamara is replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).

70' Nadir Zortea slides a brilliant pass into Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) will replace Nicolo Zaniolo.
63' Substitution. Keinan Davis (Udinese) did his best and is replaced by Adam Buksa.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) comes onto the pitch for Kingsley Ehizibue.
63' It's time for a substitution. Nadir Zortea (Bologna) comes on in place of Lorenzo De Silvestri.
62' A corner kick by Udinese is thwarted by the well prepared Federico Ravaglia (Bologna).
60' 0 - 2 GOAL! Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:2.
58' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
54' 0 - 1 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini shows great vision to find Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
52' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
50' A clumsy foul by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle.
49' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
49' Arthur Atta (Udinese) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Udinese can continue in their attacking effort.
47' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
47' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Bologna will take a throw-in.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Federico Ravaglia to dive and make a save.
45+5' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45+4' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
45+2' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is cleared to safety by the defence.
45+1' Keinan Davis (Udinese) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Arthur Atta (Udinese).
44' Nikola Moro (Bologna) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.

43' It looks like Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) saw red with that tackle. Juan Luca Sacchi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Bologna, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
41' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Maduka Okoye leaps out to thwart his attempt.
41' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is going to take the penalty!
40' It’s a PENALTY to Bologna after the VAR review!
38' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
37' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
35' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Luca Sacchi no option but to blow his whistle.
33' Arthur Atta (Udinese) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
31' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for an infringement.
30' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
29' The corner by Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
28' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
28' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
27' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
26' Nicolo Casale (Bologna) commits a rough foul. Juan Luca Sacchi stops the game and makes a call.
25' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
23' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) sends an accurate short pass. Lorenzo De Silvestri controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
23' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes.
21' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) brought his opponent down.
20' One of the players from Udinese times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
19' The free kick into the penalty area from Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) is cleared.
17' Arthur Atta (Udinese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
16' Bologna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
15' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

15' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Bologna force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
13' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
12' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
12' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. Udinese force a corner. They send men into the box.
10' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
9' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) tries to find Keinan Davis, but he puts too much power on the pass.
7' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Federico Ravaglia.
6' Bologna are ruled offside.
5' A spell of possession for Udinese in an attempt to control the game.

4' Keinan Davis (Udinese) does well to reach an overhit cross into the box from Hassane Kamara, but his first-time effort flashes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
3' Udinese players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bologna.
1' The first half has just begun.
Udinese will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Juan Luca Sacchi.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
